metadata.measurement_boundary: resident-input operation; synchronized CUDA-event stream interval and synchronized wall-clock per step; event-pair construction and one-time initialization are excluded, per-sample event recording/synchronization remains included; excludes data loading, transfer, preprocessing, and service overhead

AB2W32G1.architecture: two-convolution preactivated branch shared across two updates

A3W37G1.architecture: one-convolution preactivated branch shared across three updates

granularity_comparison.interpretation: Package comparison: AB2W32G1 uses two convolutions per update for two updates; A3W37G1 uses one convolution per update for three updates. Width and update count also differ; this is not an isolated convolution-count or width causal estimate.
granularity_comparison.speedup_baseline: AB2W32G1; existing speedup_vs_C8_wall field is retained and is null because C8 is not in this roster.
